text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, as I was taking a walk 
after finishing my meal—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—I've never felt any thrill from that. 
It's not like I've read all that many, 
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
T-That's such a waste...! There are so 
many thrilling and heart-pounding stories 
out there in the world—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. It's just as you suspected.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, I never really get the 
chance to read books. Whenever I'm killing 
time, I'm usually just fiddling around 
with cards or dice.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
S-So, it's not like you dislike it or 
anything... right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'll at least read the manga they 
have lying around diners.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I see...! P-Phew, that's a relief. As long 
as you don't dislike it, if you just have 
a chance to read it...
choice_data_list: What kind of manga do you like?

Why don't you get a recommendation from 
Rob Roy?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...It's a story about a man who lived on 
gambling. Dramatic comebacks in the 
eleventh hour, confronting unreasonable 
games—a life-or-death tale.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I see, life on the line...! In that case, 
I have just the thing! A book that 
Nakayama-san would definitely enjoy!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ah... it's not really that big of a—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you sure!? ...A-All right. I 
understand. I promise I won't let you 
down!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah... you think so? Well then, I'm 
counting on ya.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes!! Leave it to me. Please wait just a 
moment! I'll definitely have it done by 
tomorrow...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
No, don't rush so—... And she's gone. 
She's way too hyped up.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*... Um, here... You can return 
it... whenever you want... Take your time, 
read... *yaaawn*...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...You look sleepy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm sorry. I was being so picky that 
it suddenly became morning... But I'm sure 
you'll enjoy it!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Well, I'll take the favor for now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was almost time for training. Having 
finished checking today's regimen, just as 
I was about to head out—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the suddenly quiet room, Nakayama Festa 
chuckled.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"‘...In absolute silence, even a pebble 
becomes a deadly weapon.’ ...Hah, I hear 
ya."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Nah, it's nothin'. Let's get going, 
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"First is just an easy run, right? Not 
feeling any tension at all, but..."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...'With just a moment's lapse in 
vigilance, the man was tripped up from 
under him.'"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. I'd never let my guard down.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"The corpses scattered at your feet seem 
to warn of a trap lying ahead."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh... if she actually makes a move on me, 
things might get a whole lot more 
exciting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa's been acting strange for a 
while now... Could this be...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Not enough. A light breeze through 
like that won't give me what I'm looking 
for—
choice_data_list: Did you borrow a book from Rob Roy?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
………… ...I borrowed it. Something wrong 
with that?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I'm letting it get to me or 
anything. ...I'm definitely not influenced 
by it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Still, you really ought to read that one 
too.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"You get to experience a level of heat 
you'd never see in real life. A true 
life-or-death drama, y'know."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Life and death existing right next to 
each other. That's the thrill of it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she got completely hooked on it. 
Nakayama Festa turned out to be 
surprisingly easily influenced by books.
